attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and applied login-session resource limits (8192 open files, 256 processes) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified via a real login shell (su -l), then restarted node1 with the mandatory evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and account/limits state, issued a self-acknowledging reboot, confirmed the node was briefly unreachable, polled until it came back, proved the boot_id changed (8660e8f0... -> 656b844c...), and re-verified the appworker account, limits config, and enforced ulimit values post-restart.
